task: Run Astra benchmark assessment on Kaggle
what_happened: Agent exhaustively probed the Kaggle Model Proxy API and found it to be a read-only stub with no inference endpoints. All POST requests to /v1/chat/completions returned 405 (Method Not Allowed). No inference endpoints exist at any path.

endpoints-probed.GET /models: 401 Unauthorized - auth required but no endpoint defined
endpoints-probed.POST /v1/chat/completions: 405 Method Not Allowed - only GET, HEAD allowed
endpoints-probed.All other paths: 404 Not Found or 405 Method Not Allowed

root_cause: The Kaggle Model Proxy (mp-staging.kaggle.net) is configured as a read-only stub. It responds to requests but does not support POST inference calls. This is an infrastructure limitation, not a code issue.
why-previous-runs-succeeded: Previous successful assessments (this session's v2-v4 runs) used the kaggle-benchmarks SDK which handles model routing internally. The SDK likely uses direct API access or a different proxy configuration than the raw Model Proxy endpoints the external agent probed.
impact: External agents attempting to probe the Model Proxy directly for inference will fail. They must use the kaggle-benchmarks SDK's task/run mechanism instead of direct API calls.
resolution: Documented in KAGGLE-ASTRA-BENCHMARK-GUIDE.md: use `kaggle benchmarks tasks run -m gpt-6-astra` via the SDK, not direct HTTP calls to the proxy.
corrective-action: The guide now includes explicit warnings about proxy limitations and directs users to the SDK approach.
evidence: External agent probe results (see failure report)
Successful runs in this session used kaggle-benchmarks SDK (task push/run/download pattern)
